Materials and light

Across all three I'm keeping the palette quiet and letting the light do the work. Warm white lacquer on the millwork. White oak on the shelves and inside the towers, so the glow at night reads warm rather than bright. Soft rounded edges anywhere you'd touch, which fits what you said about wanting your room softer.

The LEDs sit at the back of each shelf, or in small pin lights under the floating ones, so you see a wash of light on the wood and never the strip itself. A sheer blind in a valance over the door filters the afternoon sun and disappears when it's up.

The mirror is the Umbra Hubba Pill, 62" x 18", hung with the LED halo behind it. See it on Umbra.

Wall panelling usually needs a symmetrical layout to look right, so I don't think it's the best fit for this room. A mural or another wall treatment could do a lot more here, and you'd know better than anyone how to make that sing.
